brief:
Israeli forces carried out demolition operations and artillery strikes across Gaza on Saturday, according to Shehab Wire. The military conducted what the agency described as ongoing ceasefire violations through explosive demolitions, gunfire, and artillery barrages in scattered locations throughout the territory.

The operations affected multiple areas across the sector. Demolition work focused on northern Gaza, while the military intensified fire in eastern and southern regions. A Shehab Wire correspondent reported on the strikes, which the agency said represented a continuation of repeated breaches of the ceasefire agreement.
